input_contract: Cedar-shaped JSON authorization input; CLI version probe only until native policy eval ships.
output_contract: ovk.result.v1 with policy_violation counterexamples (deterministic evaluator today)

guarantee.meaning_of_pass: Cedar policy permits only authorized actions.
guarantee.meaning_of_fail: Cedar policy reports a forbidden authorization.
guarantee.meaning_of_unknown: Cedar binary unavailable or input incomplete.

trusted_components: optional cedar CLI for version probe
limits: Does not verify runtime middleware behavior.
failure_semantics: Missing binary or incomplete input maps to unknown; evaluator errors map to error.
unsupported_semantics: Native Cedar policy evaluation is not implemented; does not verify runtime middleware behavior.
